name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD, not for production: single reactive-on-send-failure trigger (no trigger selector, back to the v0.7.0/trunk shape) plus a shutdown cleanup, both followed by a CertVerifier rebuild when cleanup finds something. Fixes (not just fences off) the duplicate-RecipientInfo corruption bug found 2026-09-01: the automatic retry now uses a freshly recreated nsIMsgComposeSecure instance, with its recipient-cert cache rewarmed via Thunderbird's own getEncryptionCompatibleRecipients()/checkRecipientCerts(), instead of reusing the failed attempt's -- so BeginCryptoEncapsulation() only ever runs once per instance.
